candidate_name: AblateCell: A Reproduce-then-Ablate Agent for Virtual Cell Repositories

tested_scope.bounded_question: Whether a directly identity-bound corresponding-author first-party surface for AblateCell exposes a paper/project/code link or immutable implementation surface that displaces the previously observed Docker/container execution dependency.
identity_chain: AblateCell arXiv and BEAM Lab publications list Siqi Sun as a co-corresponding author.
Fudan University's official faculty page for Siqi Sun gives https://intersun.github.io/ as his contact homepage.
That homepage self-identifies Siqi Sun as Fudan/Shanghai AI Lab and as leader of BeamLab, providing a non-fuzzy first-party identity binding.
tested_scope.scope_rule: Absence on this one first-party homepage and in surfaced GitHub code-search results is not evidence that no AblateCell implementation exists elsewhere.

observations.paper_execution_boundary: The current arXiv HTML states that AblateCell reproduction uses planner/executor agents in a Docker container and that the code agent performs deterministic execution inside a Docker container with the repository mounted at a stable path.
observations.corresponding_author_homepage: The directly bound Siqi Sun homepage lists 2026 news/preprints, BeamLab affiliation, and publication/code links for other work, but the inspected surface contains no AblateCell mention, AblateCell project link, repository link, or immutable implementation revision.
observations.github_code_search: A connected GitHub code search for the exact token AblateCell surfaced secondary paper summaries/indexes and unrelated lexical matches among the returned results; no surfaced result was an author- or BEAM-owned AblateCell implementation repository.
observations.repository_name_search: A connected GitHub repository-name search for AblateCell returned no repositories in the surfaced result set.
observations.scope_limit: These observations do not establish global code absence, do not establish a failed replication of CPA/GEARS/BioLORD results, and do not show that corresponding authors lack private or unindexed implementation artifacts. They only fail to locate an admissible public immutable implementation surface in this bounded slice.

reproduction_assessment.reason: The directly bound corresponding-author first-party homepage did not expose an AblateCell implementation or alternative execution path, while the paper itself still specifies Docker/container execution. Therefore the residual execution boundary remains unresolved rather than passed.
